summary: Round 2 of T16-01. All four story checks exit 0, and the round-1 blockers are fixed. The two rounds-1 fixes (codex-r1-1, codex-r1-2) are in the code and covered by tests. I also read the files directly to judge the criteria. I did not run a build with BUNDLE_VERSION set or a mock-bundle failure check by hand, so those rest on the test suite and code reading.

checks.evidence: ruff check passed, 6 files already formatted, mypy --strict: no issues in 6 source files.

checks.criterion: make -C paper (numbers, test, pdf in order)
checks.evidence: numbers wrote 0 macros, then 217 tests passed, then Tectonic 0.17.0 built main.pdf and 'check_log.py: main.log clean'.

main.tex:1-37 has article 11pt, input order, \appendix and the two appendices. The author line is Gradient Descent, \date{} is empty, and a comment says the final title is set after G5. arxiv.sty:6-14 sets geometry (letterpaper, 1in) and loads natbib (authoryear, round), amsmath, amssymb, booktabs, xcolor, graphicx and hyperref, with no fontenc or inputenc. Each section file holds only \section and \label with the 22.2 titles. abstract.tex is empty. No Appendix C exists.

generated/numbers.tex is the two comment lines (header, then 'no release bundle was read'). numbers.py:126-160 calls validate_bundle(production=True) and returns errors before writing, records bundle_version and the manifest SHA-256, and rejects macros that are unlisted, missing, null, non-finite or non-numeric. spec_errors rejects duplicate names and non-letter names. write_atomic leaves the old file in place on failure. MACROS is empty. No figures target, figures.py or measurement-review.json exists.

The 217 tests pass. The disallowed_graphics fix at test_manuscript.py:443-479 reads the starred form and reports any unreadable \includegraphics as written. test_numbers.py:138 numbers_tex_problems accepts either the header-only file or a bundle source line followed by the macro lines. I did not run the mock-bundle failure case by hand; I read it in the tests.

checks.criterion: Makefile requirements (variables, targets, tectonic-not-found message, no dependency changes)
checks.evidence: Makefile:7-22 defines TECTONIC, UV, empty BUNDLE_VERSION, the pinned TECTONIC_BUNDLE and the digest comment, and all: numbers test pdf. Lines 48-56 hold the tectonic-not-found message, the version print, the --keep-logs --bundle build and check_log. The story's own non-merge commits do not touch pyproject.toml, uv.lock, .gitignore, the root Makefile or the root README. They also do not touch config/.

It lists prerequisites, the pinned bundle and that generated/ is never edited by hand. It lists only the commands that ran, and I saw each exit 0 except numbers (the pdf, test and default targets also passed).

findings.claim: numbers.py must be run with python -P; running it directly exits with a message.
findings.evidence: This is the round-1 note, rebutted by the author. I agree with the rebuttal. The file name is fixed by the spec, the guard is documented, and every Makefile target passes -P.

resolution.reason: The reviewer agrees this is not a defect; it restates the round-1 note claude-r1-1, which was rebutted. The story fixes the file name paper/scripts/numbers.py (acceptance criterion 3). Run as python scripts/numbers.py, Python puts scripts/ first on sys.path, so any import of the standard library numbers module (decimal, fractions, pydantic via validate_bundle) would load this file instead and fail obscurely. The guard at numbers.py:203-205 turns that into a one-line message naming the fix, and every Makefile target runs python -P (Makefile:16-17, PYTHON = $(UV_RUN) python -P). make -C paper numbers, numbers-check, test and the default target all pass, so no change is needed.
